title: [Pmt. Recon. Journal] Optimize opening of the Payment Application screen
summary: Payment application screen opening is optimized by adding a date filter setting to reduce candidate records, avoiding duplicate database reads, and preventing excessive SetAutoCalcfields calls. A critical issue in DK FIK payment matching that performed unfiltered full table scans is also fixed.
key_points: Adds optional date filter setting on Payment Application Settings page to narrow candidate list
Eliminates double database reads when building temporary record sets
Reduces unnecessary SetAutoCalcfields calls for better performance
Fixes unfiltered full table scan issue in DK FIK payment matching drilldown
New index added on Vendor Ledger Entry to support date filtering
quote: Introducing a simple date filter setting on Payment Application Settings page.
